statement.zh: Bhan 等 2005 Antiquity 项目廊总结戈拉多罗贸易与手工业中心证据（含印章）。
statement.en: Bhan et al. 2005 Antiquity Project Gallery summarizes Gola Dhoro as a Harappan trading/craft centre (including seals).
